analysis:
The only change in this PR visible to me is documentation in docs/provider/cli-reference.md. At line 519, the runtime-generation benchmark row now lists `--runtime-concurrency <sizes>` and `--runtime-stagger`, and cites `RuntimeConcurrencyBenchmark`. The file_changes metadata also lists head ranges at 1145-1146, but the supplied head text stops at line 846, so I could not examine those lines. Their patch excerpt was truncated. I examined the full visible head text of the file, covering lines 1-846.

Security-relevant observations:
- The doc states that these benchmark modes run with the prefix cache off. That is consistent with T-041's posture, where the encrypted SSD prefix cache is the sole production tier. It does not widen the at-rest surface, the TTL, or the HMAC naming.
- The new flags are documentation only. No code was supplied that could show whether `RuntimeConcurrencyBenchmark` handles prompts, logs, or assistant directories. Whether it avoids writing plaintext prompts to disk or logs (T-050 and T-028 concerns) is an unverified implementation contract. I recorded it as a question and did not raise a finding.
- The logout, login and enrollment text cited at lines 456-505 and 573-587 has no visible diff and matches the A-008 and T-053 descriptions. I treated it as pre-existing.
- I found no regression, no new attack surface in the supplied evidence, and no invalidated threat-model assumption.

Remaining question: the lines 1145-1146 change is unseen. Integration should check that those lines do not alter security claims, for example around attestation, trust or cache behavior.
